reuse.why: Routes five inline midpoint copies (schedule app x2, forecast, schedule-template, preview) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes existing duplication rather than adding any; the amount rule now has one definition.

placement.why: The planning rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the API field is added in api.ts/api-models.ts where the schedule API types live.

scope.why: Focused on scheduled amounts and the API list field; the Balance.tsx and forecast `_amountOp` plumbing is needed to pass the operator.

maintainability.why: One tested helper with an explicit operator argument; callers differ in whether they pass the operator, which is visible but not documented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount resolutions now call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: Former copies were replaced by calls, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an `op` parameter and an `op === 'isapprox'` branch; no call site bypasses it.
